exposure: previous history of PPH or bleeding disorders
cohort: Women presenting to THQ hospital, Indus Hospital (Manawan Campus) Lahore with postpartum hemorrhage or who developed it after admission between January and July 2018.
finding: Of the 900 obstetrical emergency admissions, 2.2% developed postpartum hemorrhage; 85% of those with PPH were severely anemic and received blood transfusions, 30% required intensive care, and the mortality rate was 5%.
mod_finding: Of the women who experienced PPH, 35% had spontaneous vaginal delivery, 45% had cesarean section, and 20% had instrumental delivery.
